# spydersoftidentity_api_resource_secret (Resource)

A secret on a API resource. The value is hashed by the server and cannot be read back; changing any attribute replaces the secret.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "spydersoftidentity_api_resource_secret" "example" {
  api_resource = spydersoftidentity_api_resource.example.id
  value        = var.example_api_secret # sensitive; stored in state
  description  = "managed by terraform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_resource` (String) The id of the API resource that owns the secret.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) The secret value. Stored in state; protect the state file.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description.
- `expiration` (String) Expiration as an RFC 3339 timestamp.
- `type` (String) Secret type: SharedSecret, X509Thumbprint, X509Name or X509CertificateBase64.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric identifier assigned by the server.
